claim: CLTA RQ10: fast-weight plasticity beats retrieval+ICL on many-skill retention
expected: plastic model beats RAG baseline on held-out instances of skills whose demos left context
falsifier: RAG/episodic baseline matches or beats the plastic model at equivalent compute -> plasticity adds nothing for this workload; programme stops at the MVP

claim: A SINGLE-skill test would be won by retrieval (why the experiment was redesigned)
expected: on one skill with retrievable demos, RAG >= plastic
falsifier: plastic clearly beats RAG on a single skill -- would mean the capacity/composition framing is wrong and single-skill tests are fine

claim: Phase 0 fact retention (ZORG=1847) is not evidence for plasticity
falsifier: RAG fails Phase 0 -- would make fact retention a meaningful discriminator after all
